			label "menu security"
			action
				"cf: shuttle projected gross" = 0
				"cf: shuttle projected expenses" = 0
				"cf: projected route income" = "cf: shuttle local trip payout"
				"cf: projected route income" += "cf: shuttle local trip payout" * "cf: shuttle local vip" * 2
				"cf: shuttle projected gross" += "cf: projected route income" * "cf: shuttle local ships" / 4
				"cf: shuttle projected expenses" += "cf: shuttle local daily crew"
				"cf: projected route income" = "cf: shuttle regional trip payout"
				"cf: projected route income" += "cf: shuttle regional trip payout" * "cf: shuttle regional vip" * 2
				"cf: shuttle projected gross" += "cf: projected route income" * "cf: shuttle regional ships" / 6
				"cf: shuttle projected expenses" += "cf: shuttle regional daily crew"
				"cf: projected route income" = "cf: shuttle long trip payout"
				"cf: projected route income" += "cf: shuttle long trip payout" * "cf: shuttle long vip" * 2
				"cf: shuttle projected gross" += "cf: projected route income" * "cf: shuttle long ships" / 8
				"cf: shuttle projected expenses" += "cf: shuttle long daily crew"
				"cf: projected route income" = "cf: shuttle frontier trip payout"
				"cf: projected route income" += "cf: shuttle frontier trip payout" * "cf: shuttle frontier vip" * 2
				"cf: shuttle projected gross" += "cf: projected route income" * "cf: shuttle frontier ships" / 10
				"cf: shuttle projected expenses" += "cf: shuttle frontier daily crew"
				"cf: shuttle projected net" = "cf: shuttle projected gross" - "cf: shuttle projected expenses"
				"cf: mining projected gross" = 0
				"cf: mining projected expenses" = 0
				"cf: projected route income" = "cf: mining local trip payout"
				"cf: projected route income" += "cf: mining local trip payout" * "cf: mining efficiency bonus" / 100
				"cf: mining projected gross" += "cf: projected route income" * "cf: mining local ships" / 3
